what_it_does: BROCA is a specialized AI chip designed for conversational robots that run on mobile phones and battery-powered devices. It handles five tasks in a pipeline: listening to what the user says (speech) and seeing them (vision), looking up relevant information from stored documents, generating the right response using a large language model, computing the emotional tone of the response, and synthesizing speech to speak back. The key innovation is using adaptive bit-truncation (a technique that reduces the precision of numbers in different parts of the pipeline) and acoustic-cluster bit grouping (grouping related computations by how their data is organized) to minimize power consumption while preserving response quality.
